# CDR Analyzer Pro

> Offline-first web application for parsing, filtering, correlating, visualizing, and exporting telecom Call Detail Records (CDR) and SMS logs directly in the browser without uploading files to any server.

CDR Analyzer Pro supports Vodafone Idea (VI), Jio, Airtel (including VoWiFi formats), BSNL CSV datasets, binary XLS/XLSX workbooks, nested/encrypted ZIP archives, local IndexedDB v3 IMEI TAC and TRAI DLT SMS header resolution, D3 network relationship graphs, interactive Chart.js analytics, and formatted Excel exports.

## Primary Pages

- [CDR Analyzer Pro Application](https://viphacker-100.github.io/cdr-analyzer-pro/): Main single-file browser workspace for CDR upload, filtering, analysis sub-tabs, offline reference DB management, and Excel export.
- [Custom 404 Page](https://viphacker-100.github.io/cdr-analyzer-pro/404.html): Fallback error page with breadcrumb recovery and direct links back to workspace sections.

- [Project README](https://github.com/viphacker-100/cdr-analyzer-pro/blob/main/README.md): Overview, installation steps, security/privacy model, version history, and feature guide.

## Sample Operator Datasets

- [Vodafone Idea (VI) Sample CSV](https://viphacker-100.github.io/cdr-analyzer-pro/demo_cdr_vi.csv): 20 sample synthetic VI call records.
- [Reliance Jio Sample CSV](https://viphacker-100.github.io/cdr-analyzer-pro/demo_cdr_jio.csv): 21 sample synthetic Jio call records.
- [BSNL Sample CSV](https://viphacker-100.github.io/cdr-analyzer-pro/demo_cdr_bsnl.csv): 32 sample synthetic BSNL call records.
- [SMS Analysis Sample CSV](https://viphacker-100.github.io/cdr-analyzer-pro/demo_cdr_sms.csv): 36 sample synthetic SMS header records.
